server/internal/integrations/thirdparty/.reason: Third-party account queries are static, but migration must preserve account row projection and secret-store lookups as one repository change.

server/internal/platform/logging/reposit.reason: Management log list and cursor-boundary queries compose optional filters and variable IN clauses; static insert, detail, and pruning queries use sqlc.

server/internal/plugins/storage/config.g.reason: Plugin config selective reads compose a variable key IN clause; namespace-wide reads and writes use sqlc.

server/internal/plugins/storage/kv.go.reason: Plugin KV prefix listing uses SQLite LIKE ESCAPE syntax that sqlc v1.31.1 cannot parse.

server/internal/render/repository.go.reason: Current template cache cleanup composes variable template and plugin ID NOT IN clauses; current template reads and writes use sqlc.

server/internal/storage/integrity.go.reason: Storage integrity uses SQLite PRAGMA quick_check.

server/internal/storage/snapshot.go.reason: Storage snapshot uses PRAGMA setup and VACUUM INTO maintenance SQL.

server/internal/storage/store.go.reason: Storage lifecycle runs WAL checkpoint maintenance.

server/internal/storage/store_open.go.reason: Storage open configures SQLite PRAGMA settings.

server/internal/storage/store_schema.go.reason: Storage initialization executes the current schema atomically and records and reads its initialization metadata.
